verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's primary metric model is Fact Tables, where you write SQL against your own warehouse rows and define multiple metrics on top of them (docs-68, docs-9). It queries 11 warehouse sources including BigQuery, Snowflake and Databricks (gh-3). Independent users confirm it works on their existing data, for example by exposing views over click-stream data, and supports any metric expressible as a query, unlike walled-garden metric stores (comm-1, comm-6). missing for 10: explicit documentation of defining metrics from GrowthBook-ingested events without a warehouse (only implied by the pricing page's 'no need to connect your data warehouse')
